name: Staggering Melancholy
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [despair, emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, lathspell 2, mesmerist 2, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (a bit of rat fur)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels).

Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The target of the spell is struck with a profound sense of hopelessness. For the duration of the spell, the target is staggered and despairing. Each round at the beginning of their turn, a creature affected by this spell can attempt a new save. This is a move action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity.
